name: Dub Anything
description: Dub library videos with a Codex or Claude Code director.

versions.changelog:
Add Pause and Resume for queued or running jobs. Running work reaches a completed
tool step before pausing, preserving saved progress. Paused jobs stay paused
across restarts. Display concise job errors with expandable diagnostic details.

Move optional worker, director, language-setup, installer, and release tooling
into scripts/integrations/. Direct dubs continue to use scripts/dub_anything.py.
Update documentation, tests, installation commands, and release automation for
the layout. Bundled compatibility launchers let older installed updaters upgrade
and roll back safely; settings, queue, and working files keep their paths.

Includes the CTranslate2 short-window crash guard, Refresh log control, and
disabled Queue dub styling introduced in the preceding patch releases.

Fix a CTranslate2 native crash while generating Whisper word timings for a
window with fewer than two usable mel frames. The guard preserves normal word
timings and the existing CUDA/cuDNN dependencies.

The Jellyfin dashboard now has a Refresh log button below each expanded job log.
Queue dub appears disabled until a library video and an available director are
selected. Plugin and worker updates continue to install together only when idle.

Respect hidden controls even when Jellyfin's button styles set an explicit
display mode. Clarify direct dubbing versus optional Jellyfin entry points in
the agent instructions and script guide; established script paths stay intact.

Fix a CTranslate2 native crash while generating Whisper word timings for a
window with fewer than two usable mel frames. The guard preserves normal word
timings and the existing CUDA/cuDNN dependencies.

The Jellyfin dashboard now has a Refresh log button below each expanded job log.
Queue dub appears disabled until a library video and an available director are
selected. Plugin and worker updates continue to install together only when idle.

Coordinated automatic updates for the Jellyfin plugin and local worker.
Updates wait for the dub queue to become idle, retain the previous installation,
and restore it if startup verification fails. Includes the initial Jellyfin
dashboard, Codex/Claude Code directing, and language setup workflow.
